The third sheet set.
The Bed and Bedding Zone in the Primary Bedroom. The bed and the linens on it have one job, which is to get you through the night without waking up.

What done looks like:
1. Bed made the same way every morning: fitted sheet
2. Flat sheet or duvet
3. Two sleeping pillows per person
4. One throw folded at the foot. Two complete sheet sets for this bed

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success bed and bedding zone.
